question: The annual elephant rejuvenation camp held in September 2025 was conducted in which of the following tiger reserves of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **annual elephant rejuvenation camp**, often referred to as the **Hathi Mahotsav**, was successfully organized in **September 2025** at the **Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve** located in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• This **7-day** long event is a traditional ritual designed to provide a much-needed break and health boost to the captive elephants that serve the **Forest Department** throughout the year.
 
• During this period, the elephants are exempted from their regular duties, such as **wildlife monitoring**, **rescue operations**, and **anti-poaching patrolling** in the dense terrains of the reserve.
 
• The rejuvenation process involves a specialized **nutritious diet** prepared for each elephant, which includes a mix of **jaggery, coconuts, sugarcane, bananas, apples**, and **bajra khichdi** mixed with vitamins and minerals.
